author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Campanella’s in Cranston is scheduled to reopen September 16, bringing the longtime restaurant back after a closure tied to court-supervised receivership proceedings.

The Campanella family purchased the restaurant from a court-appointed receiver several months ago and is preparing the dining room and kitchen for a grand reopening. The return restores a familiar local name and puts the business back under family ownership.

The restaurant entered receivership after a business dispute and fraud allegations involving Andrew Loffredo in May. Those claims are allegations, and this report does not treat them as proven. The receivership provided the legal process through which the property and operating assets could be transferred.

Owners announced the reopening date Monday. Details such as regular hours, reservations and the full opening menu may be updated closer to September 16, so customers should check the restaurant’s official channels before visiting. The confirmed development is that the family completed the purchase and has set a public date to resume service.
dek: The longtime restaurant is preparing to welcome customers back after the Campanella family purchased it from a court-appointed receiver.
headline: Campanella’s in Cranston plans September 16 reopening
